sources.quote: HD 18742 is an 8th-magnitude subgiant star located about 530 light-years (160 pc) away in the constellation of Eridanus.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 5.9 solar radii and 2.10 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,190 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.quote: It is orbited by one confirmed exoplanet, super-Jupiter HD 18742 b, and possibly by another Jovian planetary candidate.
